title.zh: Circle’s Arc launch ties Wall Street firms to the network without making them its safety net
title.en: Circle’s Arc launch ties Wall Street firms to the network without making them its safety net

current_state.zh: Circle is launching its Arc blockchain on Sept. 16 with BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, Mastercard, and ICE among 11 founding validators, linking major financial institutions to the network as operators, investors, and prospective users.
current_state.en: Circle is launching its Arc blockchain on Sept. 16 with BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, Mastercard, and ICE among 11 founding validators, linking major financial institutions to the network as operators, investors, and prospective users.
